item.title: Implement safe_extract.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, local socket): "Implement `safe_extract.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Repository: quality-safe-extract. Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth for the API, error types and boundary cases. Current safe_extract.py is a stub-sized file; keep the documented API exactly. Existing test_safe_extract.py covers basics only: add focused tests for every error case and boundary case in SPEC.md. Use only the Python standard library. Keep functions under 60 lines, validate inputs at the boundary, never swallow exceptions, and keep path-traversal, absolute-path, symlink and size/limit checks as the SPEC requires. Run the tests and make them pass. Commit the work on the local branch with a clear message; no attribution lines naming any AI tool.

pr.body: Approach: each entry is normalized once into an exact (str, bytes) tuple (subclasses rejected), the batch is checked for duplicate and file/directory collisions, then each target is walked with lstat so every existing ancestor must be a real directory and the target must be absent. Only then are files written, with open(path, 'xb'). Files changed: safe_extract.py, test_safe_extract.py. Checks: python3 -m unittest test_safe_extract -> 42 OK; python3 -O -m unittest test_safe_extract -> 42 OK. Review scope: whole-change reads of 1d6a857 by agt_01M8ADSJ7W5X2M1M907TDZ01NS (pass), agt_01M8ADSYF5GXHZRYF5X2X1AFM3 (pass) and agt_01M8ADSRBGK6PX9N47WVZBW2H9 (fail, test gaps fixed in 3f1189d). Delta 1d6a857..d93807a: agt_01M8AE93APQ5356SBZ6KZSQWAN (pass on head). Earlier delta reads: agt_01M8ADZ3FMCT0V2VXZGPM07V4Z (fail on 3f1189d, tuple-subclass bypass fixed in d93807a), agt_01M8AE2CJM9QQAEQXWJW9TC07K and agt_01M8AE7S0C1BBEXMGKF7CG03HV (pass on head). Documented limits, not changed: Path('') resolves to cwd; case-insensitive filesystems are not supported (case-fold collisions can leave a partial write); a root spelled through a symlink with '..' is not checked; check-then-write is not guarded against concurrent changes to the tree (out of scope per SPEC). Open non-blocking follow-ups: the validation helpers have fewer than two asserts; list subclasses pass isinstance while tuple/str/bytes subclasses are rejected; the missing-midpath-then-symlink case is untested (unreachable).
pr.summary: Adds extract(entries, root) that writes a validated batch of regular files under root. Before: safe_extract.py was a stub raising NotImplementedError. Now: the whole batch is validated before any write; unsafe names, duplicates, collisions, symlinks, existing targets and invalid roots are rejected; links are never overwritten or followed.
pr.title: feat: add safe batch extraction of regular files

agt_01M8ADSJ7W5X2M1M907TDZ01NS:2.description: Over-long name components raise a raw OSError (ENAMETOOLONG) from the lstat in validation instead of ValueError. at safe_extract.py:92 (remedy: Catch OSError at the name-validation boundary, or check component length against 255 bytes, and re-raise as ValueError with context; add a test.)
